title: An Update for Our Football Fans
message:
We've heard you, and we know how much the Sports section means to many of you.

Over the past few weeks, we've been working hard to improve and expand the Omnivue experience. However, the Sports section hasn't been delivering the level of reliability we'd like you to experience.

Rather than continue offering an inconsistent experience, we've made the decision to temporarily take down the Sports section as we work towards making it better and more dependable.

We know this may be disappointing, especially for those who rely on Omnivue to follow their favourite games. We're genuinely sorry for the inconvenience. This isn't goodbye to sports on Omnivue; it's a step towards bringing it back in a better state.

If you encounter broken links, playback issues or anything that doesn't seem right in other sections, please reach out through our Help Center. Your feedback helps us identify issues and improve your experience.

Thank you for your patience, understanding and continued support as we build a better Omnivue!

title: A Fresh New Look for Live TV
message:
Live TV is getting a fresh new look! We've redesigned the interface to make browsing and navigating your favourite channels simpler and more enjoyable.

Explore the updated layout, featuring neatly organized categories such as Local, Entertainment and Sports, alongside Watch History for quicker access to previously watched channels and an improved EPG to help you keep track of your favourite broadcasts.

Enjoy the refreshed Live TV experience!
